Maps
Maps
We have a wide range of natural resource maps for recreation and commercial activities. Use the dropdown menu to search by topic or enter your own keywords to search for a particular map. You can interact with most of these maps with features such as zoom in/out and overlays.
Select: All Most Popular Hunting Recreation Canoeing/Kayaking Rivers & Streams Fishing Snowshoeing Skiing Snowmobiling Keyword search: Start a new search
Map Details |
Aerated Lakes , web map
Lakes with an aeration system.
|
Aquatic Invasive Species Decontamination Sites , web map
Locations of aquatic invasive species decontamination stations by scheduled date.
|
Aquatic Management Areas , web map
Boundaries and water bodies within more than 700 management areas. Includes total acres, allowed uses and area office contact information.
|
Bear Permit Area Map , web map
Displays bear permit areas.
|
Buffer Protection , web map
Public waters and public ditch systems requiring permanent vegetation buffers.
|
Chronic Wasting Disease Management and Surveillance , web map, pdf or image
Deer permit areas and chronic wasting disease sampling stations for the various deer season hunts.
|
Climate Trends , web map
Climate trends by geographic unit, climate variable, and time frame.
|
Compiled Sand and Gravel and Crushed Stone Resources for Completed Projects , web map
Compilation of GIS aggregate resources (sand and gravel, crushed stone) reconnaissance scale data spanning twenty-seven county projects completed 1987-present.
|
Conservation Officer Patrol Areas , web map
View conservation officer patrol areas around Minnesota.
|
Cooperative Groundwater Monitoring (CGM) , web map
Groundwater resources to help determine trends, interpret impacts of pumping and climate, plan for water conservation, and evaluate water conflicts.
|
Cooperative Stream Gaging (CSG) , web map
Near real-time and historical streamflow and water quality data, site information and photos. Includes US Drought Monitor, Current weekly stream flow report, Major and Minor watershed boundaries, and Current NEXRAD radar image.
|
County Groundwater Atlas , pdf or image
Geology and groundwater resources of a county, including the groundwater quality, quantity, and sensitivity to pollution.
|
Dam Finder , web map
Information on existing dams, removed dams, dams under construction, and small structures exempt from dam safety jurisdiction in Minnesota.
|
Deer Hunting Seasons , pdf or image
Season dates by deer permit areas/zones, management designations, CWD areas, and localized hunting restrictions and regulations
|
Deer Winter Severity Index , pdf or image
General measure of winter conditions, current and previous, used to predict overwinter deer survival.
|
Drill Core Library and Mineral Exploration Collections , web map
Geographic distribution of core and other samples stored at the DNR drill core library.
|
Fall Color Finder , pdf or image
Current leaf color status statewide.
|
Fishing in the Neighborhood , pdf or image
Seven county metro area lakes that are stocked with easy to catch fish species and shore fishing options.
|
Fishing piers and shore fishing sites , web map
Locations of fishing piers and shore fishing sites.
|
Forest Legacy: Public Hunting , web map
Hunting and other recreation opportunities on Forest Legacy land.
|
Horseback Riding Maps , pdf or image
View horseback riding trails in Minnesota.
|
Hunter Walking Trails , web map, pdf or image
Hunter walking trails that provide access to grouse and woodcock hunting areas.
|
Hydraulic Model Download (FEMA) , web map
Stream segment model information. View and download stream segment model information. View and download FEMA hydraulic models.
|
Interactive Snowmobile Trails , web map
Snowmobile trails across the state. Image file and/or KML for Google Earth.
|
Interactive Water Trail Map , web map
Water trails, including dams, rapids, hazards, accesses, camping, and rest areas.
|
Lake Ice In Dates , web map
Current lake ice in dates received by citizen volunteer lake ice observers.
|
Lake Ice Out Dates , web map
Current and historical lake ice out dates received by citizen volunteer lake ice observers.
|
LakeFinder , pdf or image
Data for more than 4,500 lakes and rivers throughout Minnesota, including lake surveys, lake depth maps, lake water quality data, lake water clarity data, lake notes, and fish consumption guidance.
|
Minnesota Great Outdoors , web map
Search for Minnesota outdoor recreation facilities in both state and regional parks and trails.
|
Minnesota Hydrogeology Atlas (MHA) , pdf or image

|
Mississippi River Low Flow Management , web map

|
Mobile Maps , web map
Recreation maps in GeoPDF format. Download and print the PDF's or view coordinates on the map using a mobile or tablet device. View on a mobile device with or without cellular service/wifi.
|
National Wetland Inventory (NWI) , web map
Location and characteristics of wetlands in Minnesota. Used in wetland regulation and management, land use and conservation planning, environmental impact assessment, and natural resource inventories.
|
Native Plant Community and Rare Species County Maps , pdf or image
Statewide and county maps of Minnesota's Biological Survey of native plant communities and rare species maps. Available as PDF maps and shapefiles via the Minnesota Geospatial Commons.
|
Off-Highway Vehicle Trails , pdf or image
Off-highway high vehicle (OHV) trails. PDF files for viewing or print.
|
Parkfinder , web map
State parks identified by recreation types and amenities.
|
Permit Areas: Bear Hunting , pdf or image
Bear permit area boundaries.
|
Permit Areas: Deer Hunting , web map, pdf or image
Deer permit area boundaries.
|
Public Water Access Maps by County , pdf or image
Public water access locations (boat launches) and fishing piers.
|
Public Waters Inventory Maps , pdf or image
Water basins and water courses that meet the criteria set forth in Minnesota Statutes, Section 103G.005, subd. 15. Public Waters.
|
Recreation Compass , web map
State and federal parks, forests, land and water trails, water bodies, wildlife refuges and management areas, waterfowl production areas, scientific natural areas, water accesses, walk-in access sites.
|
Report a Bear Sighting , web map
Bear range and reported bear sighting locations. Includes a data entry form for members of the public to enter bear sightings outside of the typical bear range in the state.
|
River Levels , web map
Real-time river levels and flow volume.
|
Ruffed Grouse Management Areas (RGMA) , web map, pdf or image
Ruffed grouse management areas by title and location, destination for the hunter looking to experience grouse and woodcock hunting
|
School Trust Aggregate Finder , web map
Sand, gravel, and crushed stone resources on school trust lands.
|
School Trust Lands (image) , pdf or image
Printable map of School Trust Lands in the northern portion of Minnesota.
|
School Trust Lands (web map) , web map
Minnesota's 2.5 million acres of School Trust Lands and 1 million acres of severed mineral rights.
|
Scientific and Natural Areas (SNA) , web map
Public lands open to recreational activities that do not disturb natural conditions.
|
Ski Pass Trail Maps , interactive
Find information about ski trail locations where you can use your Great Minnesota Ski Pass.
|
Snow Depth and Groomed Trail Conditions , pdf or image
Winter ski and snowmobile trail conditions.
|
Spring Inventory , web map
Spring location information including physical, chemical, and historical data.
|
State Forests , pdf or image
State forests and campground or day-use areas.
|
State Nonferrous Metallic Mineral Leasing , web map
Negotiated and active state nonferrous metallic mineral leases.
|
State Parks , pdf or image
State parks by location.
|
State Trails , pdf or image
State trails by location.
|
State Water Trails , pdf or image
State water trails by location.
|
Statewide fire danger and current burning restrictions , pdf or image
These two maps are updated daily throughout the active fire season. They show the current fire danger locations and the areas in which debris burning is restricted.
|
Topography of Minnesota (MnTOPO) , web map
View, print, and download high-resolution elevation data for Minnesota collected using LiDAR technology.
|
Turkey Hunting Seasons , pdf or image
Outlines Turkey Permit Areas (TPAs) and turkey hunting seasons
|
Turkey Permit Area Map , web map
Map of turkey permit areas.
|
Underground Mines , web map
Geospatial data for the Underground Mine Mapping Project.
|
Visual Sensitivity Classifications , web map
Classification of the visual sensitivity of highways, roads, designated recreation trails, lakes, and rivers in 16 Minnesota counties with heavily forested areas.
|
Walk-In Access (WIA): By County , web map
Private land sites designated for WIA public hunting by county with site specific printable PDF maps. Users can download a KML file and GPS data.
|
Walk-In Access (WIA): Hunting Atlas , pdf or image
Private land sites designated for WIA public hunting.
|
Watershed Health Assessment Framework (WHAF): Explorer , web map
Displays watershed health scores across a range of spatial boundaries, access to hundreds of additional data layers, and links to watershed reports and data summaries.
|
Watershed Health Assessment Framework (WHAF): Lakes , web map
This application provides lake health scores within a user selected spatial boundary. Different aspects of lake health can be easily compared, while also exploring conditions both in and near a selected lake.
|
Weekly Snow Depth and Rank , pdf or image
Weekly and historical data on snow depth.
|
Weekly Stream Flow , pdf or image
Stream flow conditions from 1990 - present.
|
What's Under Your House , web map
